features.name: x1_standardized
features.description: z-score normalization of x1 using training mean and std for stable linear margin scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth standardized input enabling stable linear SVM weight estimation.

features.name: x6_standardized
features.description: z-score normalization of x6 (high-variance feature) clipped to a safe band.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces scale dominance of x6 in linear margin computation.

features.name: x9_standardized
features.description: z-score normalization of x9 for linear projection compatibility.
features.expected_model_benefit: Makes x9 magnitude comparable to other features for SVM hyperplane.

features.name: x9_over_x2_abs_ratio
features.description: Ratio of x9 to absolute value of x2 capturing relative magnitude composite.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous ratio feature useful as a smooth linear discriminant input.

features.name: x4_x6_interaction
features.description: Standardized product interaction between x4 and x6 capturing co-movement.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an explicit pairwise term to enrich the linear margin without kernelization.

features.name: x5_severity
features.description: Absolute value of x5 reflecting distance from zero in the bounded [-1,1] range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous severity measure for linear discrimination.

features.name: x10_minus_floor_norm
features.description: Normalized position of x10 in its bounded [1000,1200] range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Maps x10 to unit interval for stable linear projection.

features.name: x7_yes_indicator
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides categorical signal directly usable in linear SVM weighting.

features.name: x8_large_indicator
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes the minority size category for linear margin contribution.

features.name: x3_red_indicator
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures one of three category levels for linear separation.

features.name: weighted_linear_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of standardized continuous predictors used as a smoothed linear margin proxy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Pre-aggregated linear projection that gives SVM a strong directional signal.

features.name: interaction_semantic_coherence
features.description: Semantic judgment score (0 to 1) assessing whether the combination of categorical attributes (x3 color, x7 yes/no, x8 size) forms a typical co-occurrence pattern based on training-fold marginal frequencies; higher values indicate more common joint categorical configurations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures categorical typicality as a smooth scalar useful for SVM margins beyond one-hot encodings.
